# NNNN - <decision title>

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Proposed / Accepted / Rejected / Superseded by NNNN |
| Date | YYYY-MM-DD |
| Deciders | names / roles |
| Plan references | e.g. enterprise-plan/21 §5 |

## Context
What problem or force makes a decision necessary? Include constraints (HUTCH, licence, security, cost).

## Decision
The decision, stated in one or two sentences, then the details.

## Alternatives considered
| Option | Why not chosen |
|---|---|

## Consequences
Positive, negative, and what must now be true (tests, docs, follow-ups).

## Compliance
How we will know the decision is being followed (CI check, review rule, metric).
